sentences.text: Mum and Dad had a new tent.
He had to milk the cows.
“What a lot of cows!” said Wilf.
“We milk them every day,” he said.
“I want some eggs too,” said Mum.
Mrs Jones was expecting a baby.
Everyone went to bed but there was a storm.
The wind blew the tent down.
They had to go to the farmhouse.
Mrs Jones had to go to hospital.
The wind blew a big tree down.
Mr and Mrs Jones went back to the house.
Mr Jones pointed to a field.
“The helicopter can land there,” he said.
They made a big cross out of the bags.
They put stones on the bags.
There was a doctor in the helicopter.
The doctor ran to the house but Mum came to the door.
